data_provenance.integrity_basis: Recorded official download URLs and local SHA256, not publisher signatures

definitions.hourly_task: Supplied six-hour-shifted challenge labels, including post-onset hours; labels are not shifted again.
definitions.average_precision: Stepwise average precision, not trapezoidal precision-recall area.
definitions.challenge_utility: Official normalized hourly challenge utility; the alert cooldown is not applied.
definitions.event_sensitivity: Detected eligible pre-onset events / all eligible pre-onset events; warning window [inferred onset − 6, inferred onset).
definitions.false_alerts_per_patient_day: False alert episodes / (eligible non-warning patient-hours / 24). Includes never-septic hours and eligible septic hours before onset − 6; excludes warning/post-onset hours and censored septic cases. Six-hour alert cooldown.
definitions.intervals: Available report-supplied 95% patient-cluster percentile intervals; separate marginal intervals are not a significance test.
definitions.selective: Withheld predictions count as no alert. Event sensitivity retains all eligible events in its denominator. Events with all warning hours withheld are a subset of events with any warning hour withheld.

selective.method: Absolute probability distance from frozen decision threshold
